questions.question: Why would it be necessary to analyze an electrical system before increasing the load on the system?
questions.idealAnswer: To make sure the generator, wire size, and circuit breaker capacities won't be exceeded.

concepts.label: Circuit breaker capacities won t exceeded
terms: circuit breaker capacities won t exceeded

conceptGroups.label: Circuit breaker capacities won t exceeded
acceptedTerms: circuit breaker capacities won t exceeded

questions.question: What is the relationship between the inside diameter of a conduit and the outside diameter of the wire bundle inside of it?
questions.idealAnswer: The conduit needs to be 25% larger than the wire bundle.

questions.question: What is the proper length for a bonding jumper?
questions.idealAnswer: As short as practical, but long enough to allow free movement.

questions.question: Under what conditions must the switch be de-rated from its nominal rating?
questions.idealAnswer: When used for circuits with a high in-rush of current, DC motors, and inductive circuits.

questions.question: At what point do electric motors draw the most current?
questions.idealAnswer: They draw the most current during starting.

questions.question: Circuit Breakers are designed to open before what condition occurs?
questions.idealAnswer: Before the circuit overheats and emits smoke.

questions.question: At what point in the circuit should the protective device be located?
questions.idealAnswer: As close to the power source as possible.

questions.question: What type of circuit breaker may not be used in an aircraft?
questions.idealAnswer: An automatic resetting circuit breaker

questions.question: What part of an aircraft is identified by a white navigation light?
questions.idealAnswer: The tail

questions.question: What should be done when making bonding or grounding connections between dissimilar metals?
questions.idealAnswer: Use a suitable washer so that any corrosion will occur on the washer.

questions.question: Prior to making a continuity check, what must be done to an electrical circuit?
questions.idealAnswer: Turn the power off and isolate the section to be checked.
